items.q: What does it mean that the Messages API is stateless?
items.a: The server keeps **no memory between requests**. Each request must contain everything the model needs, including the conversation history, which the client stores and resends.
items.trap: Confusing stateless with "no conversation possible". Conversations work fine; the client carries the state.

items.q: A long chat is getting slow and expensive. What would you do?
items.a: Measure tokens per turn, then **trim old turns in pairs**, summarise older context, or keep facts in a store and add only what's relevant. Prompt caching cuts the cost of the unchanged prefix.
items.trap: "Use a model with a bigger context window." That delays the problem and raises the bill.

captions.text: Har chat app aur har agent asal mein ek conversation hai: messages ki ek list, jo
time ke saath badhti jaati hai.
Iss lesson mein aap dekhoge ki API kuch bhi yaad nahi rakhti, history aapke code ki
zimmedari hai, aur badhti history ka matlab hai badhta bill.
Iss lesson ke baad aap explain kar paoge ki stateless ka matlab kya hai.
Multi turn conversation sahi tareeke se banaoge.
Forgotten reply wala classic bug pakdoge aur fix karoge.
Aur lambi conversations ko control mein rakhna seekhoge.
Pehle what: stateless ka matlab kya hai?
Ek call centre socho, jiske paas customers ka koi record nahi hai.
Har baar call karo, toh ek naya agent phone uthata hai, jo aapke baare mein kuch
nahi jaanta.
Purani problem par help chahiye, toh poori kahani phirse sunani padegi.
API bilkul aise hi kaam karti hai.
Har request akeli hai.
Why aisa design kiya gaya?
Kyunki stateless servers simple hote hain aur scale karna aasaan hota hai.
Koi bhi server kisi bhi request ko handle kar sakta hai.
Lekin iska matlab hai ki memory ka kaam aapke code ko karna hai.
Ab how: ek conversation actually kaise chalti hai.
Pehli request mein ek user message hota hai.
API reply karti hai, aur phir sab bhool jaati hai.
Aapki app user message aur reply, dono ko ek list mein store karti hai.
Doosri request poori list bhejti hai: pehla question, pehla reply, aur naya
question.
Aur teesri request paanch messages bhejti hai.
Roles alternate hote hain, user, assistant, user.
Aur pehla message hamesha user ka hota hai.
Ab code.
History bas ek Python list hai, message dictionaries ki.
Har question ke liye, pehle usse history mein append karo, phir poori list messages
mein bhejo.
Phir assistant ka reply bhi append karo.
Yahi woh line hai jo log aksar bhool jaate hain.
Phir hum print karte hain kitne messages bheje, aur kitne input tokens lage.
Right side dekho: pehle turn mein ek message gaya, aur paanch input tokens.
Doosre turn mein teen messages gaye, aur input tokens badh gaye.
Offline fake bhi bata raha hai ki iss request ke saath kitne purane messages aaye.
Aur teesre turn mein paanch messages.
Har request apne se pehle ka sab kuch dobara bhejti hai, isliye input tokens har
turn badhte hain.
Isko ek table mein dry run karte hain.
Turn one: history mein sirf ek user message hai.
Ek message gaya, paanch tokens.
Turn two: pehla question, pehla reply, aur naya question.
Teen messages, unhattar tokens.
Turn three: paanch messages, ek sau chaar tokens.
Ab ek classic bug.
Yeh loop har question append karta hai, lekin reply kabhi nahi.
Output dekho: user, user.
Koi assistant turn hi nahi hai.
API isse accept kar leti hai aur dono user messages ko ek turn mein merge kar deti
hai.
Lekin model ko kabhi pata nahi chalta ki usne pehle kya bola tha.
Chat app mein yeh aisa lagta hai jaise assistant ki memory chali gayi ho.
Isliye reply milte hi usse store karo.
Har turn poori history dobara bhejta hai, toh lambi conversations slow aur mehengi
ho jaati hain, aur aakhir mein context window bhar jaati hai.
Iske kuch standard solutions hain.
Sabse simple hai sliding window: sirf latest turns rakho, aur budget cross hone par
sabse purana user aur assistant pair hata do.
Hamara project yahi karta hai.
Doosra option: purane turns ko model se ek chhoti summary mein badal do.
Yeh Module 6 mein aayega.
Teesra: important facts ek database mein save karo, aur sirf relevant facts wapas
add karo.
Aur prompt caching: conversation ka jo starting hissa change nahi hua, usse dobara
bhejne par bahut kam bill lagta hai.
Course mein aage yeh use karenge.
Trimming ka ek dry run.
Maan lo history hai user one, assistant one, user two, assistant two, user three,
aur budget cross ho gaya.
Toh pehla pair hatao: user one aur assistant one, saath mein.
Ab history hai user two, assistant two, user three.
Budget ke andar hai, toh bhej do.
Aur yeh galat tareeka hai: sirf user one hataya, toh history assistant se shuru
hogi.
Roles ka order toot jaata hai.
Interview corner.
Messages API stateless hai, iska kya matlab hai?
Answer: server requests ke beech koi memory nahi rakhta.
Har request mein woh sab hona chahiye jo model ko chahiye, history ke saath, jo
client store karta hai aur dobara bhejta hai.
Trap: stateless ka matlab yeh nahi ki conversation possible nahi.
Conversation chalti hai, bas state client ke paas hai.
Doosra, scenario based question: ek lambi chat slow aur mehengi ho rahi hai.
Aap kya karoge?
Answer: pehle har turn ke tokens measure karo.
Phir purane turns ko pairs mein trim karo, purana context summarise karo, ya facts
ek store mein rakho aur sirf relevant wale add karo.
Prompt caching unchanged hisse ki cost kam karti hai.
Trap: bas badi context window wala model le lo.
Isse problem sirf aage khisakti hai, aur bill badhta hai.
Practice time.
Pehla: conversation mein das messages hain.
Agli request kitne messages bhejegi?
Doosra: forgetful dot py ko fix karo, aur batao fix ke baad kaun se roles print
honge.
Teesra: ek trim function likho, jo sabse purane pairs hataye.
Aur scenario: users complain karte hain ki error ke baad bot sab bhool jaata hai.
Aapka code kya galti kar raha hoga?
Quick check.
Conversation mein pehle se das messages hain.
Agli request kitne messages bhejegi?
Gyaarah.
Saare das purane messages, aur ek naya.
Jab tak aap jaan boojhkar history trim nahi karte.
Recap.
API stateless hai, aur history aapka code rakhta hai.
Har turn question aur reply, dono append karo.
Har turn ke saath input tokens aur cost badhte hain.
Isliye pairs mein trim karo, ya summarise karo.
Agle lesson mein aap output ko control karoge: length limits, streaming, aur
structured JSON.
